name: mesh-orchid
title: Orchid Wallpaper
description: Original gradient-mesh wallpaper in the Orchid palette. Scalable SVG, under 2 KB, no raster assets.

files.content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 800" width="1200" height="800" role="img" aria-label="envoyai Orchid gradient mesh">
  <title>envoyai — Orchid</title>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="mesh-orchid-g0" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c084fc" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c084fc" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="mesh-orchid-g1" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f0abfc" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f0abfc" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="mesh-orchid-g2" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#581c87" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#581c87" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="mesh-orchid-g3" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#150425" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#150425" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="mesh-orchid-base" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#150425"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="mesh-orchid-grain">
      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.9" numOctaves="3" stitchTiles="stitch"/>
      <feColorMatrix type="saturate" values="0"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  <rect width="1200" height="800" fill="url(#mesh-orchid-base)"/>
    <circle cx="264" cy="224.00000000000003" r="496" fill="url(#mesh-orchid-g0)"/>
    <circle cx="936" cy="176" r="432" fill="url(#mesh-orchid-g1)"/>
    <circle cx="744" cy="624" r="544" fill="url(#mesh-orchid-g2)"/>
    <circle cx="144" cy="656" r="384" fill="url(#mesh-orchid-g3)"/>
  <rect width="1200" height="800" filter="url(#mesh-orchid-grain)" opacity="0.06"/>
</svg>
